samples.summary: Todo doc describes a private `applyDecimalDelta(delta)` method on `Spreadsheet` that was never implemented; the actual shared logic lives in `Sheet.changeDecimals(delta)`, and `Spreadsheet.increaseDecimals`/`decreaseDecimals` just call `this.sheet.changeDecimals(±1)`.
samples.evidence: "3. `Spreadsheet.increaseDecimals` / `decreaseDecimals` collapse onto one private `applyDecimalDelta(delta)`:" — but packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:534-549 shows increaseDecimals/decreaseDecimals unchanged in shape, each simply delegating to `this.sheet.changeDecimals(1)` / `changeDecimals(-1)`; the consolidated logic (target computation, unset-then-fallback) actually lives in `Sheet.changeDecimals` at packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4195-4218, not in a `Spreadsheet.applyDecimalDelta` method.
